text: 11. ALCOHOLS, PHENOLS AND ETHERS
summary: Alcohols, phenols, and ethers are important classes of organic compounds characterized by their functional groups: alcohols have a hydroxyl group (-OH) attached to a saturated carbon atom, phenols have a hydroxyl group attached to an aromatic ring, and ethers have two alkyl or aryl groups bonded to each oxygen atom. These compounds play crucial roles in biological processes and industrial applications, influencing properties such as solubility, reactivity, and polarity.
